results.title: Random tensor stabilizer distribution
results.question: Determine the limiting distribution of full stabilizers, beyond scalar kernels, for iid tensors in critically unbalanced growing formats over a fixed finite field.
results.result: Compute the full stabilizer law and all-target witness algorithm in the sharply rectangular critical window.

results.title: Bit-uniform genus-two pseudo-isometry with unrestricted local multiplicities
results.question: Given a two-dimensional space of alternating matrices over F_q, compute its full pseudo-isometry group generators in polynomial matrix dimension and log q time, without restrictions on repeated primary blocks or characteristic.
results.result: Construct full pseudo-isometry generators for regular split alternating pencils with supplied roots and field generator, including repeated blocks in characteristic two.

results.title: All-field determinant image of tensor stabilizers
results.question: Compute the determinant-character image of a finite-field tensor stabilizer in polynomial bit time without enumerating the stabilizer, so GL transporters can be tested for SL compatibility.
results.result: Compute the exact stabilizer determinant image and decide special-linear transport on a rank-certified castling class over every finite field.

results.title: Bounded treewidth of spectral block interactions
results.question: Give polynomial-bit-time exact O/U TI when spectral-block interaction hypergraphs have bounded treewidth, while block dimensions and connected-component sizes grow.
results.result: Decide exact orthogonal or unitary transport on full-rank matrix forests with unbounded block sizes and rational Gram spectra.

results.title: Nonlinear automorphisms of additive codes beyond affine actions
results.question: Given an additive subgroup of F_q^n and the corresponding Hamming metric, determine when every Hamming isometry from its domain to itself is induced by a coordinate automorphism of the whole Hamming space.
results.result: Extend every isometry of a binary linear code under a checkable pair-sum condition, and give an explicit nonextendible example.

results.title: Dyadic quadratic epimorphisms
results.question: Decide in polynomial Cayley-table time whether one class-two exponent-four 2-group surjects onto another with a prescribed central image. Treat the induced quadratic square map as part of the witness.
results.result: Construct marked exponent-four epimorphisms onto targets with a one-dimensional Frattini subgroup using complete scalar square-form data.

results.title: Exact count of optimal faithful G-sets
results.question: For arbitrary finite Cayley-table groups, count isomorphism types of faithful G-sets attaining the minimum degree without enumerating every optimal subgroup tuple.
results.result: Count all minimum-degree faithful actions of finite abelian groups, with the additional order-four elementary cases at the prime two.

results.title: Algorithmic compatibility of two marked normal sections
results.question: For compact solvable group presentations with two intersecting characteristic abelian normal subgroups, test whether given isomorphisms on each quotient can be lifted by a single group isomorphism, without expanding the group.
results.result: Lift two compatible quotient isomorphisms through abelian ideals over a finite field by constructive module isomorphism.

results.title: A principal congruence generator algorithm from filtered ring data
results.question: Given a finite additive ring presentation and its Jacobson radical filtration, compute a short presentation for 1+J and exact word coordinates in uniform NC with unrestricted filtration length.
results.result: Compute normal forms and short presentations for principal congruence groups in uniform NC over a fixed prime field with an adapted filtration basis.

results.title: Computational recognition of minimal transitivity
results.question: Determine the complexity of testing from generators whether a transitive permutation group has no proper transitive subgroup. Seek polynomial algorithms for broad nonsolvable families or hardness.
results.result: Recognize minimal transitivity in Cartesian products of supplied nonabelian simple actions, with fixed-parameter time in the largest point stabilizer order.

results.title: Sharp regular representation of generic quadratic powers
results.question: Determine the minimum affine representation size of powers of a nondegenerate quadratic over C under the regularity condition at the origin.
results.result: Construct regular determinant pencils for quadratic powers with sharp size along the stated powers and dimensions.

results.title: Factoring modulo prime powers
results.question: Can a proper nontrivial factor, or a certificate of irreducibility, of a degree-d polynomial modulo p^k be found in randomized polynomial(d,k,log p) time?
results.result: Lift prime-power factorizations to arbitrary precision in a recognized integral Newton scaling regime.

results.title: Recovering the hidden affine coordinates of an ROABP
results.question: Given black-box access to a promised fixed-width ROABP in unknown affine coordinates, return both an invertible change of variables and a width-bounded ROABP in polynomial time when the polynomial is concise.
results.result: Recover exact rational affine coordinates of concise hidden width-one ROABPs in deterministic polynomial bit time.

results.title: PC degree versus rational coefficient size on a fixed CSP language
results.question: Give an explicit fixed finite-domain language whose PC ideal memberships have constant-degree proofs over Q but whose constant-degree proofs necessarily contain a coefficient of superpolynomial bit length, or prove a polynomial-bit certificate theorem for the class.
results.result: Control proof bit size without raising polynomial-calculus degree for signed binomial axioms.

results.title: Succinct separating invariants
results.question: Can polynomial-size arithmetic circuits encode separating invariants for arbitrary explicitly presented connected reductive actions over C?
results.result: Construct uniformly separating invariant monomials on every coordinate stratum for a fixed-rank binary-weight torus.

results.title: Linear-time canonical simultaneous permutation conjugacy
results.question: Given a connected permutation tuple of unbounded tuple length in an explicit array model, compute its canonical simultaneous-conjugacy representative in linear total input time, extending the fixed-arity map algorithm.
results.result: Canonize a connected tuple of permutations in linear time given the stated cycle-signature certificate or a transitive constituent cycle.

results.title: Sharp complexity of disconnected simultaneous conjugacy
results.question: Determine the optimal deterministic complexity of canonical simultaneous conjugacy for arbitrary permutation tuples with repeated disconnected components, including duplicate-component identification without superlinear comparison overhead.
results.result: Assemble and deduplicate connected tuple canonizations in deterministic linear time, preserving the total input bound.

results.title: Worst-case partial-deck threshold
results.question: Determine the maximum over reconstructible n-vertex graphs of the minimum number of vertex-deleted cards needed to identify the graph, and obtain asymptotically sharp bounds.
results.result: Compute exact adversarial partial-deck thresholds of all cluster graphs against arbitrary competitors, together with ally thresholds.

results.title: Cancellation-free separating graph invariants
results.question: Determine whether polynomial-size monotone arithmetic circuits evaluating nonnegative combinations of subgraph orbit sums can separate every Boolean graph orbit, or prove an exponential monotone lower bound.
results.result: Build monotone polynomial-size invariants for ordinary refinement and for separation of a specified spectral twin class from every competitor.

results.title: Exact reuse across overlapping two-shell neighborhoods
results.question: Characterize host graph decompositions for which two-shell information gives provable asymptotic savings for exact induced motif enumeration with no double counting.
results.result: Count induced motifs exactly on hosts with one- and two-terminal pieces and binary repetition counts.

results.title: Structural criterion for quantum compactness
results.question: Find an effectively checkable combinatorial or coherent-algebra criterion equivalent to QP(A)=S(A), rather than just the established implication to classical compactness.
results.result: Decide quantum compactness and compute the quantum orbital partition when walk-seeded refinement separates twin classes.

GP-0391.result: For finite abelian groups, the number of minimum actions up to twisting is one plus the floor of half the number of direct order-two factors.
